Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Koulikoro: Gérémi Dolo elected President of the Regional Office of the CDM in the region
Mali.summary: Koulikoro, 21 November (AMAP) During a ceremony held this Saturday in the conference room of the traditional authorities and leaders, the regional executive of the Collective for the Defence of the Military, chaired by Mr Geremi Dolo, was approved. He chairs a consensus committee of 27 members from the CDM committees in the Koulikoro region. .

Mali.title: Mali: 2,261 tanker trucks have arrived in Bamako since the beginning of November
Mali.summary: A new convoy of 756 tanker trucks carrying petroleum products arrived in Bamako on the night of Friday, 20 November to Saturday, 21 November 2026, bringing the number of fuel transport vehicles sent to the Malian capital since the beginning of the month to 2,261, according to a report from the Directorate General for Trade, Consumption and Competition (DGCC) relayed by the local press.

Mali.title: Counter-terrorism: airstrikes and neutralisations in the Kidal and Niono areas
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national public that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their ongoing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. . On Wednesday, 18 November 2026, the use of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, one hundred and nineteen (119) kilometres south-west of Kidal, a meeting point for armed terrorist groups bringing together several individuals, including leaders, as well as military equipment, including vehicles.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: The army announces strikes near Kidal and Niono
Mali.summary: In a statement released on Saturday, 21 November, the General Staff of the Armed Forces said it had carried out several airstrikes against armed terrorist groups between 18 and 21 November 2026, in the regions of Kidal and Niono. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are continuing Operation Dougoukoloko with the support of their partners . They ensure the surveillance and security of the territory.

Mali.title: Hydrocarbon supply: 2,261 tanker trucks transported to Bamako in three convoys since the beginning of November
Mali.summary: Bamako, 21 November 2026 – The supply of petroleum products to the Malian capital continues, with sustained mobilisation of state services. During the night from Friday to Saturday, 21 November, a new convoy of 756 tanker trucks arrived at the parking areas in Bamako, escorted by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa). .

Mali.title: The Sahel’s Dangerous Calm: What Does the Lull in Jihadist Fighting Really Hide?
Mali.summary: The reported easing of fighting between jihadist rivals in the Mali-Burkina Faso-Niger tri-border region may look like relief for governments struggling to contain an expanding insurgency. It should not be read that way. After months of fierce confrontations between Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) and Islamic State Sahel Province (ISSP), clashes between the two have reportedly slowed since late October.

Mali.title: Mali: A Russian officer highlights the unprecedented nature of the raid that freed 24 soldiers
Mali.summary: An officer from the Russian special forces of the Africa Corps, known by the call sign Kosmos, highlighted the exceptional nature of the military operation that led to the release of 24 Malian soldiers near In-Tebezas, in the Kidal region. . Indeed, in an interview with Sputnik, he stated that no such intervention had yet been carried out successfully in Africa, referring in particular to a similar attempt by the US military in Mogadishu, Somalia, which reportedly ended in failure.

Mali.title: "Today, Russia is no longer afraid to claim responsibility for armed action in Africa"
Mali.summary: "War crimes", "murders", "acts of torture"... At the end of September, Amnesty International reported "overwhelming evidence" of atrocities committed by Russian Wagner paramilitaries between 2023 and 2025 in Mali. Despite the group's withdrawal in 2025 in favour of Africa Corps, a new organisation directly linked to the Russian Ministry of Defence, civilians have not been spared.

Mali.title: Over 76,000 Burkinabés repatriated from Guinea following measures against illegal gold mining
Mali.summary: Since the beginning of November, Guinea has intensified operations against illegal gold panning, particularly in the gold-rich Siguiri region (north-east). The government accuses this activity of causing significant environmental damage and claims to want to put an end to the unregulated exploitation of mineral resources. .

Mali.title: GOONGA TAN: Mali: After Kidal, a lull...
Mali.summary: GOONGA TAN: Mali: After Kidal, a lull? The press release from the Armed Forces' Directorate of Information and Public Relations (DIRPA), published on 23 October 2026, deserves more than a mere cursory reading. Behind the figures announced lies a military sequence that could mark a turning point in the conduct of the war against armed terrorist groups.

Burkina Faso.title: Fire at the ZACA project: The Minister of Security calls for compliance with the regulations for transporting dangerous goods
Burkina Faso.summary: On Friday, 20 November 2026, the Minister of Security, Comrade Mahamadou SANA, visited the site of the fire that occurred at the ZACA project in Ouagadougou, in order to assess the damage and familiarise himself with the situation alongside the security forces. According to initial findings, the fire, which broke out the previous day at around 7 p.m., was reportedly linked to poorly packaged insecticides and not to explosives.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso/Literature: Sylvestre Yakoro recounts his captivity in his book “Bɔbɔkɛ, VDP contre l'ignorance” (“Bɔbɔkɛ, VDP against Ignorance”)
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso/Literature: Sylvestre Yakoro recounts his captivity in his book "Bɔbɔkɛ, VDP against ignorance" On Saturday, 21 November 2026, in Ouagadougou, the Burkinabé writer Sylvestre Yakoro held a book signing for his work entitled "Bɔbɔkɛ, VDP against ignorance". This book recounts his personal experience when he was captured by armed men in 2023. Burkinabé literature is enriched by a new book Indeed, Sylvestre Yakoro, inspector of primary education, presented his book entitled "Bɔbɔkɛ, VDP against ignorance".

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: Cybercriminals claimed 956 victims and defrauded over CFAF 261 million in October 2023
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso: Cybercriminals claimed 956 victims and defrauded more than CFAF 261 million in October 2026 Cybercrime continues to claim victims in Burkina Faso. In October 2026, 956 people were affected by cybercrime, resulting in financial losses estimated at over CFAF 261 million. .
